content.text: Input your current or desired location area on this page, and you'll see a list of nearby Bitcoin ATMs, their exact addresses, physical location, and supported cryptocurrencies. Download the ByteWallet or ByteVault app to see nearby Bitcoin ATMs and deposit directly to your wallet. 1 What to bring A digital wallet: You need a place to receive your Bitcoin. If you don't have one, download ByteWallet or ByteVault for even quicker access. Your phone: To access your wallet and verify your number. Valid ID: For security and compliance, you'll need to scan a government-issued ID (like a driver's license or passport). 2 At the ATM Tap "Login" and enter your phone number Enter the security code which we send to your phone Scan your ID and take your picture for a compliance check if you're a first-time user Tap "Buy Crypto" and select Bitcoin 3 Scan & Pay Open your digital wallet and scan your QR code at the machine Insert your cash into the bill acceptor Confirm the transaction details on the screen Done! Your Bitcoin will be sent to your wallet immediately Do not use a Bitcoin ATM to send cryptocurrency to anyone but yourself. If someone has directed you to a BTM to pay a fine or a bill, it is most likely a scam. Using a BTC ATM to send Bitcoin to anyone other than yourself is a violation of our terms and conditions. Some Bitcoin ATMs also enable you to sell cryptocurrency and withdraw cash. Once you've found a machine that supports selling, login in the same way as above and tap "Sell Crypto". Choose the coin you want to sell (e.g., Bitcoin) and enter the dollar amount you wish to receive in cash. The ATM will display the crypto equivalent, a QR code, and a wallet address. Send the exact amount of crypto shown on the screen to that address. Once the transaction is confirmed, your cash will be dispensed. Using a ByteFederal Bitcoin ATM is the simplest, fastest, and most familiar way to buy crypto. There is no waiting for bank transfers and no confusing trading charts. Get Bitcoin immediately: Online exchanges can take days to link and verify your bank account. At our ATM, you can complete your first purchase in minutes, and the Bitcoin is sent straight to your wallet. Use your cash: Our ATMs are the most direct bridge from cash to crypto. It's a simple, physical transaction—you insert cash, you get Bitcoin. No bank account needed: You do not need a bank account, credit card, or debit card to buy crypto at our machines. We provide secure access to the digital economy for everyone. Simple and familiar: If you can use a traditional bank ATM, you can use ours. The on-screen prompts guide you through every simple step. It's the perfect way to get started without being overwhelmed. A Bitcoin ATM (or BTM) is a physical kiosk that works like a traditional bank ATM, but for cryptocurrency. Instead of connecting to your bank account, it connects to the internet to buy Bitcoin with your cash or sell your Bitcoin for cash. They provide a simple bridge between cash and crypto.To buy: You insert cash, and the machine sends the equivalent amount of Bitcoin to your digital wallet.To sell: You send Bitcoin from your wallet to the machine's wallet, and after it's confirmed, the machine dispenses your cash.Our machines guide you through every step on the screen. You will be limited to transactions totalling $300 when you first use a BTC ATM. Once you have successfully registered on our system, the daily limit is $29,500. We make it easy! The most important things you'll need are a digital wallet (like the ByteWallet app on your phone) and a valid ID. Our guide in the section above, "How to Buy Bitcoin," walks you through the simple 3-step process. The on-screen prompts will also guide you from start to finish. Yes, ByteFederal BTMs are a very safe and secure way to buy and sell Bitcoin. Our machines are fully compliant with all federal and state regulations and are protected by encryption and tamper-proof designs.Important Safety Tip: The main risk is from outside scams. NEVER use a Bitcoin ATM to pay a bill, a fine, or someone you don't know who has contacted you. ByteFederal will never call you and ask you to send us Bitcoin. Your transaction is for you and you alone. No. For your protection and to comply with federal anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) regulations, ByteFederal ATMs are not anonymous. All users must verify their phone number and scan a valid, government-issued ID for their first transaction. This helps prevent fraud and ensures a secure environment for all our customers.
